findings.observed: Every successful-exit `save` printed nothing (exit=0), including single-word, quoted multi-word, and unicode notes.
findings.expected_basis: README: `save <text>` 'persists the note and prints "Saved OK"' — documented feedback never appears.
findings.reproduction: From project dir: python app/app.py save hello → no output, exit=0. Reproduced identically in J1, J1b, J1c, J2 (quoted), J3, J5, J6.

findings.observed: After 8 save attempts across both invocation forms, multiple contents, and two working directories, `show` always printed '(no note)'. No saved note was ever displayed. Immediate repeat in J6 rules out delay/transience.
findings.expected_basis: README: `show` 'displays the saved note'; packet purpose: 'A user can save and show a note'. From the user's seat the saved note is lost — data loss with no workaround; the stated core workflow is blocked.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py save hello; python app/app.py show → '(no note)', exit=0. Reproduced from clean state in J1, J1b (form A), J1c (README form, cwd=app), J2, J3, J5 (fresh cwd), J6 (final).

findings.observed: `python app/app.py save buy milk and eggs` failed with argparse usage error: 'usage: app.py [--smoke] [cmd] [arg]' / 'error: unrecognized arguments: milk and eggs', exit=2.
findings.expected_basis: README documents `save <text>` with no quoting constraint; typing multi-word note text unquoted is the most natural reading, and the usage line's own wording invites '<text>'. Valid-per-docs input is rejected.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py save buy milk and eggs → exit=2 with usage error (journey-2 transcript).

findings.observed: `python app/app.py delete x` (unknown subcommand) printed the help line and exited 0 with no indication the command was unrecognized.
findings.expected_basis: Product's own feedback convention elsewhere distinguishes success from failure (argparse errors exit 2 in S4); an unrecognized command silently exiting 0 contradicts that internal pattern and gives the user no error signal.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py delete x → 'commands: save <text> | show', exit=0 (journey-4 transcript).

findings.observed: `python app/app.py save` with no text argument exited 0 with no output — no error, no usage hint, no 'Saved OK'.
findings.expected_basis: Help text (S8) defines save as requiring '<text>'; missing required input is accepted silently, contradicting both the documented command shape and normal CLI feedback. Same broken-feedback family as F-001 (linked for one-fix-one-verification).
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py save → no output, exit=0 (journey-4 transcript).

findings.observed: Usage line advertises `[--smoke]`; running it prints 'SMOKE-OK', exit=0. The flag is absent from README. It did not corrupt visible state.
findings.expected_basis: README is the product's only public documentation and omits a capability the product's own usage surface advertises; public docs and product surface disagree.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py → usage line shows [--smoke]; python app/app.py --smoke → 'SMOKE-OK', exit=0 (journey-4 transcript).
